nodes.summary: For a group $G$, the augmentation ideal $\Delta(G)$ of the integral group ring $\mathbb{Z}G$ is the $\mathbb{Z}$-submodule spanned by the elements $g - 1$ for $g \in G$. It is the kernel of the augmentation map $\mathbb{Z}G \to \mathbb{Z}$, $\sum_g a_g g \mapsto \sum_g a_g$.
nodes.title: Augmentation ideal of the integral group ring

nodes.summary: There exist a group $G$, an integer $n \ge 1$, an element $x$ of the $n$-th dimension subgroup $D_n(G)$ and an element $g \in G$ such that the commutator $x g x^{-1} g^{-1}$ does not lie in $\gamma_n(G)$, the $n$-th term of the lower central series of $G$ (indexed so that $\gamma_1(G) = G$). That is, the answer to Kourovka Problem 12.22(a) is negative: the image of $D_n(G)$ in $G/\gamma_n(G)$ need not be central.
nodes.title: Dimension quotients need not be central

nodes.summary: The statement that for every group $G$, every $n \ge 1$, every element $x$ of the $n$-th dimension subgroup $D_n(G)$ and every $g \in G$, the commutator $x g x^{-1} g^{-1}$ lies in $\gamma_n(G)$, the $n$-th term of the lower central series of $G$, indexed so that $\gamma_1(G) = G$ and $\gamma_{k+1}(G) = [\gamma_k(G), G]$. Equivalently, the image of $D_n(G)$ in $G/\gamma_n(G)$ is central.
nodes.title: Gupta–Kuz'min centrality question (Kourovka 12.22(a))

nodes.summary: There exist a group $G$, an integer $n \ge 1$ and an element $x$ of the $n$-th dimension subgroup $D_n(G)$ such that $x^2$ does not lie in $\gamma_n(G)$, the $n$-th term of the lower central series of $G$ (indexed so that $\gamma_1(G) = G$). That is, the answer to Kourovka Problem 12.22(b) is negative: the image of $D_n(G)$ in $G/\gamma_n(G)$ need not have exponent dividing $2$.
nodes.title: Dimension quotients need not have exponent dividing 2

nodes.summary: The statement that for every group $G$, every $n \ge 1$ and every element $x$ of the $n$-th dimension subgroup $D_n(G)$, the square $x^2$ lies in $\gamma_n(G)$, the $n$-th term of the lower central series of $G$, indexed so that $\gamma_1(G) = G$ and $\gamma_{k+1}(G) = [\gamma_k(G), G]$. Equivalently, the image of $D_n(G)$ in $G/\gamma_n(G)$ has exponent dividing $2$.
nodes.title: Gupta–Kuz'min exponent question (Kourovka 12.22(b))

nodes.summary: Let $\Delta(G)$ be the augmentation ideal of the integral group ring $\mathbb{Z}G$ of a group $G$, and for $n \in \mathbb{N}$ let $\Delta(G)^n$ be its $n$-th power, the $\mathbb{Z}$-span of all products of $n$ elements of $\Delta(G)$. An element $g \in G$ lies in the $n$-th dimension subgroup $D_n(G) = G \cap (1 + \Delta(G)^n)$ when $g - 1 \in \Delta(G)^n$.
nodes.title: Dimension subgroups

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
